subject: Limited forensic access + timeboxed residency concession request
messages:
From: Alex Connors <security@medivant.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.example
Cc: legal@medivant.com
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forensic access & residency — MEDIVANT / Redwood private deployment

Rishi,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We are close to deciding on Redwood Private, but security needs one operational concession to proceed: the ability to request a short, auditable forensic session against our tenant in the customer's VPC for up to 48 hours in the event of a suspected data leak or regulatory inquiry.

Key asks from our side:
- A time-limited forensic window (48 hours) where Medivant can request access logs and a Redwood-run snapshot for incident triage.
- Residency: we need a 6-month timeboxed residency guarantee for customer data to remain in us-east-1 before any relocation (if needed).
- Evidence: SOC2 in-scope artifacts and a short MRA-style addendum to ensure access procedures are documented.

We realize this is non-standard. If Redwood can accommodate these as a narrowly-scoped concession (and include a short NDA/forensics SOP), we can finalize a pilot and lock in a 12-month committed spend. Please advise what approvals and commercial concessions you need.

Attached: Medivant-Forensic-Checklist.pdf (redacted checklist we typically use).

—Alex
Alex Connors
Head of Security, Medivant Technologies
[Attachment: Medivant-Forensic-Checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example>
To: Alex Connors <security@medivant.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example, naomi_feldman@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forensic access & residency — MEDIVANT / Redwood private deployment

Alex —

Appreciate the clarity and the checklist. We can support a narrowly scoped forensic session and a six-month residency window in us-east-1, but we need to align internally on the exact controls, timing, and commercial trade-offs.

High level proposal from Redwood:
- Forensic window: Redwood operations will perform the forensic snapshot on behalf of Medivant (no direct customer console access). Redwood staff will run a pre-agreed runbook; evidence artifacts (logs, snapshot metadata, chain-of-custody) will be delivered within the 48-hour window.
- Residency: 6 months guaranteed in us-east-1 with an explicit relocation process thereafter (30 days notice + customer approval).
- Commercial: to accommodate the operational overhead and compliance work (MRA addendum + SOP + NDA), we would ask for a 5% one-time Professional Services credit and a one-time 6% reduction to list for the first 12 months.

Can you confirm Medivant would accept Redwood-run snapshots (with mutually agreed SOP) rather than direct host access? If so, I need executive signoff on the discount and legal approval on the addendum. Looping in Marissa (sales ops) and Naomi (legal) for approvals and to list any missing items.

Regards,

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed-mra-addendum.docx (docx)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.example
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.example, marissa_cole@redwood.example, naomi_feldman@redwood.example
Date: Wed, 20 Mar 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: FWD: Forensic access & residency — Medivant (exec approval request)

Laura —

Forwarding a short ask from Medivant (DL-4129). They want: 48-hour forensic session, 6-month us-east-1 residency guarantee, plus SOC2 artifacts and an MRA-style addendum. I proposed Redwood-run snapshots only (no direct customer host access) and suggested a commercial concession: 6% off list for 12 months + 5% PS credit to cover onboarding/legal work.

Decision needed:
- Exec approval for the 6% introductory discount (one-time applied across months 1–12) and 5% PS credit?
- Approval to deliver a limited forensic process (Redwood-run snapshot, runbook, chain-of-custody) capped at 48 hours per request and limited to 3 requests per rolling 12 months unless otherwise negotiated?

Notes:
- Legal flagged that we should require a customer-signed forensics SOP and a narrow NDA/MTU addendum; Naomi can draft.
- Risk: repeated forensic windows increase operational load; recommend we cap frequency (3/year) and require incident thresholds.

Proposed executive ask to approve now (fast track) so Marissa can update quote and legal can prepare the addendum: approve the above commercial concession and the operational constraints.

—Rishi

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.example
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.example, marissa_cole@redwood.example, naomi_feldman@redwood.example
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FWD: Forensic access & residency — Medivant (exec approval request)

Rishi —

Thanks for the summary. I approve an exception with the following firm conditions:

1) Commercial concession limited to a 5% introductory discount for months 1–12 (not 6%), plus a one-time 5% Professional Services credit applied at onboarding. Do not change list price otherwise.
2) Forensics: Redwood-run snapshot only. Customer must sign the Forensics SOP and the narrow NDA addendum before any forensic activity.
3) Operational caps: up to 3 forensic windows per 12-month period; each request limited to 72 hours (we'll extend to 72 to give ops breathing room) and subject to Redwood incident thresholds.
4) Residency: 6-month guaranteed residency in us-east-1 with a relocation process requiring 30 days' notice and written customer consent.
5) Legal: Naomi to own drafting the MRA/addendum and coordinate with Medivant legal. Sales Ops (Marissa) to issue revised SOW/quote and update deal record DL-4129.

Please get Medivant's confirmation on Redwood-run snapshots and have legal circulate the addendum template. If Medivant insists on direct host access or a larger discount, route back to me for approval.

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

[Inline note: CC-ing Prioym for quota/comp implication; Marissa to reflect concession in deal desk entry. Naomi, please prioritize the MRA draft and attach to DocuSign link above when ready.]
